provenance: S-014 TK-002 (Foundry Vertical Slice Model). Extracts core component C-003 (socket registry) from prose into a machine-resolvable contract.
note: One record per K-### socket. Each record declares the module-agnostic contract only — capability + contract surface + the request/response/invariant contract — never the implementation. This artifact TRAVELS with the Sockets family. Instance binding rows (which module fills a socket here) live in the GPT_OS Project Source Registry and validate AGAINST this contract; they are not stored here. Recall (K-001) carries a derived mirror of the ID map, but this Git artifact is canonical and wins on disagreement.

K-001.capability: Derived, provenance-bearing memory/context retrieval over approved canon, plus capture-class storage for DB-native data. The Wiki remembers; the recall module recalls.

fields.id: Optional bare typed ID (e.g. K-003, P-010) to resolve to its current name, source, and provenance.

fields.source: Provenance pointer to the canonical file/path/note the value derives from.
fields.freshness: One of fresh | stale | offline | unknown, carrying an asOf timestamp.

invariants: Every recall answer exposes source (provenance) and freshness; an answer without both is not contract-conformant.
Recall is a derived mirror. When a recall answer disagrees with the Git-canonical registry, the registry wins and the mirror is stale.
A consumer reaches recall ONLY through the declared entrypoint. Reading the recall module's files or database directly is a reach-around and is not a valid connection through this socket.

K-005.capability: Validate and execute exact claim, handoff, repair, parent/child, and terminal lifecycle transitions with one atomic state-plus-Journal commit under cooperative exact-tip compare-and-swap.

invariants: The primitive is stage-agnostic and performs no target mutation when schema, scope, tip, trusted Gatehouse evaluation, or Journal validation fails.
An adopting instance binds the real Gatehouse evaluator, policy provenance, Job Order identity/revision, exact grant, and gates before accepting requests; none is caller-replaceable.
A caller-claimed Clearance must match that bound evaluator's decision and compiled-policy digest.
Every accepted mutation contains lifecycle state and exactly one Knowledge-validated Journal event in the same canonical tree and returns an exact-commit recovery receipt.
Denial persistence is non-recursive; repair has a one-attempt scope-bound budget; parent/child redelivery is idempotent; Projection is post-commit and cannot roll back authority.
The contract never self-claims, widens scope, accepts its own work, or advances a protected branch.

K-006.capability: Validate, canonically encode, digest-chain, replay, recover, and project health for immutable Grounding Journal events paired with lifecycle state.

invariants: Canonical encoding, sequence, prior digest, state pairing, idempotency, replay, and privacy checks are deterministic.
Recovery exact-matches the expected Journal digest before journal-health Projection can be fresh.
State without its event and an event without its paired state both fail closed.
The contract validates Grounding and never grants authority or mutates lifecycle state.
